goal: add a congestion charge of 10 dollars

options.title: $10 charge at all inlets
options.rationale: The model shows 14,322 fewer car commuters, 12,054 more transit commuters, 904 fewer delay hours, and 156 fewer tonnes of CO2. Its total value is still about -$108.5M per year because mobility costs (-$204.7M) outweigh the economy gain (+$89.0M). Reported revenue is only $142,720, and the rent pressure index rises by 0.25.

options.title: $10 charge plus car-free Clementina and Sutter Streets
options.rationale: Adding two car-free streets to the citywide charge gives a better total than the charge alone, about -$92.6M per year against -$108.5M. It also gives 378 new social ties against 41, 1,512 more walkers, revenue of $349,037, and 912 fewer delay hours. The total is still negative because mobility costs (-$204.8M) remain, and the rent pressure index is higher at 0.28, with 21 street edges closed.

options.title: $10 charge at the Folsom · 6th St inlet only
options.rationale: Charging only this one inlet has a small effect and a negative total of about -$0.95M per year. It removes 147 car commuters, 126 of whom the model counts as 'gone', meaning they stop making the trip. Delay rises by 9 hours and revenue is -$3,363, so it is a weak option that mostly costs people access.
